places-poieni-rambusoi-clit-fata-chiceri.story: From Poieni it runs 163 km to Poieni; allow about 2 h 49 of riding. It goes by way of Buciumi - Pădurea Dosu, Frontiers of the Roman Empire - Dacia, Cliț - Fața Chicerii and back through Frontiers of the Roman Empire - Dacia. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: A-121 Ladoga and Sortavala
scenicChapters.narrative: 35 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

places-southern-battery-no-2-scientific-.story: 305 km from Kronstadt to Kronstadt, about 5 h 16 of riding. On the way it passes The I.Repin Estate «The Penates», Historic Centre of Saint Petersburg and Re, The Babolovsky Park and Scientific Town-Institution of Physiologis. The line favours views over speed.
